title: Law audit with more time: first actual observation
instructions: Inputs, expected output, actual output and differences are shown in order. The agent evaluates the returned claims against the saved source image. Comments are optional; this is not a permission request. Enter your name to comment, Save draft to keep unfinished feedback, or Submit review to send it.

questions.prompt: Optional comments to steer later work

evidence.label: 1 · Inputs: original text, image and older model proposal
evidence.text:
The compact audit receives four source targets in two law columns. All original target text, the image and the complete older proposal are retained. The model is asked to report source-supported discrepancies and inspection coverage for every target; this is an audit, not a new corrected transcription. The following are exact excerpts for orientation, in original OCR then older-proposal order:

Chap. CCCXL — An Act to remove tte Office

Chap. CCCXLI.—An Act to remove the Office

with- out

Only repeated diagnostic descriptions are stored as a table; decoding restores the full original input exactly in software checks. The image, original words, older proposal and reply requirements are preserved. Expected answers below were saved separately before these calls and were not inserted into the model prompt.

evidence.label: 4 · Differences: agent evaluation against the source
evidence.text:
Run 1 — A reply returned after182.97seconds with10816input/1500outputtokens, then ended at the output cap. JSONis truncated and host export invalid; group stops1of3. Visible fragment notices savedCCCXLIversus rawCCCXL but wrongly says the crop showsCCCXL; actual print isCCCXI. It also questions supported may-be/Wisconsin/comma repairs as number/word-count concerns. No complete audit or corrected source reading was produced.

This case group stopped after its first attempt. Planned observations 2 and 3 are not executed: Provider finish_reason length at1500tokens; incomplete JSON. Original group stop rule forbids dependent repetitions. This failure is retained; no retry or replacement follows.

The detailed assessment records each source check and any extra finding. Software format checks, model self-reports, source-image AI assessment and human judgment remain separate. Agreement between repeated calls alone is not accuracy. Original sources, older proposals and human answers are unchanged.

evidence.label: 5 · Costs, capacity and remaining limits
evidence.text: Observed request cycles total 182.97 seconds. Known reported usage totals 10,816 input and 1,500 output tokens; 0 calls have unknown usage. The complete original audit request is retained. Earlier literal text counts exceed the 6,000 reporting threshold before image accounting; this is not proof of internal input fit. The output-token cap remains 1,500. This distinct experiment explicitly changes the lifecycle allowance from 120 to 300 seconds; prior stopped groups remain unchanged. The same wire request is used. An incomplete or truncated reply remains a failure, and unknown usage or owned exit prevents dependent calls. No retries, source fetches, model downloads, Computer Use or corpus-wide run.
